title: Libsm64: Mario 64 as a library for use in external game engines
summary: Libsm64 is an open-source project that extracts Super Mario 64's core game logic, physics, and collision systems into a reusable C library that can be integrated into external game engines like Unity, Unreal, or Godot, allowing developers to use authentic Mario gameplay mechanics in their own projects.
problem_solved: Provides open-source access to Super Mario 64's gameplay mechanics without requiring developers to reverse-engineer the game from scratch.
why_valuable: Enables authentic retro game physics and mechanics to be reused in modern games, preserving gaming history while democratizing game development.
